MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre - Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre - Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre - Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer
